{"claims":[
  {
    "confidence": "medium",
    "failing_input": "tryCatch(DEFAULT_ROPE, x=0, y=7.9, vx=1, vy=0). Here handX=0 and handY=7.9+2.1=10, exactly at the anchor (0,10), so r=0.",
    "file": "src/sim/rope.ts",
    "line": 45,
    "summary": "tryCatch allows a zero grip radius and then divides the tangent speed by that radius.",
    "why": "The reach test passes (distance 0 <= 0.35) and line 41 does not reject handY == anchorY, so omega becomes 1/0 = Infinity (NaN if vx=0); swingStep then also divides by grip=0 and produces NaN/Infinity instead of a finite swing."
  },
  {
    "confidence": "high",
    "failing_input": "Hold h={x:0,y:10}; Hang s={hold:0, theta:0, omega:1, ox:0.6, oy:0.48, et:8}. This is reachable from a regrab because hypot(0.6/1.2, 0.48/0.6) < 1.",
    "file": "src/sim/holds.ts",
    "line": 123,
    "summary": "releaseHang returns a middle/feet position that ignores the still-active hand-easing offset.",
    "why": "During the hang the middle is at h + handOffset(s) + comDistance*(sin, -cos) = (0.6, 9.43), but releaseHang returns feet (0, 7.9), implying a middle of (0, 8.95): an instant jump of about 0.77 m, contradicting the lines 119-120 promise that the middle keeps its place and the path stays continuous."
  },
  {
    "confidence": "medium",
    "failing_input": "bounce(vyIn=-3, DEFAULT_TRAMPOLINE, pressAtTick=26). The bounce leaves the bed at about tick 21 and reaches its deepest point at about tick 10-11, so tick 26 is after leaving the bed but only about 0.12-0.13 s from the deepest tick.",
    "file": "src/sim/trampoline.ts",
    "line": 57,
    "summary": "bounce adds the pump gain for a press even when that press happened after the feet had already left the bed.",
    "why": "Lines 54-57 only compare pressAtTick with deepestTick; they never check pressAtTick <= ticksOnBed. For the input above the fade formula still gives a positive share (roughly 0.25-0.4), so vyOut is increased and pumped=true although line 53 says only a press while on the bed helps."
  },
  {
    "confidence": "low",
    "failing_input": "Terrain with ground platform {x0:-10,x1:0,top:0} and wall platform {x0:0.4,x1:5,top:2}; call findClimb(t, x=-0.1, y=0, vx=0, vy=-5).",
    "file": "src/sim/climb.ts",
    "line": 73,
    "summary": "findClimb's catch-speed test is one-sided, so it accepts a catch while falling much faster than CLIMB_CATCH_VY.",
    "why": "The test only rejects vy > 2.0, so vy=-5 passes; here below=2.0 is within CLIMB_STAND_REACH and the wall is below climbMaxRise, so a Climb is returned even though the body is moving at 5 m/s, violating the lines 14 and 22 promise that the hands can close only while the body is slow / upward speed is at most 2 m/s."
  },
  {
    "confidence": "low",
    "failing_input": "Terrain with current platform {x0:-10,x1:2,top:0} and target platform {x0:2,x1:2.1,top:1}; call findVault(t, x=0, y=0, vx=7).",
    "file": "src/sim/vault.ts",
    "line": 41,
    "summary": "For a very short platform top, the computed vault landing point can lie beyond the platform's far edge.",
    "why": "takeoffDistance(7,1)=2.19 so the gap of 2 m passes, but x1 = max(2.15, min(2.5, 2.0, 2.05)) = 2.15, which is past p.x1=2.1; the vault therefore ends 0.05 m beyond the top it is supposed to come down on (and y1 is sampled at that off-platform x)."
  }
]}
